name: sssf-visualizer
description: Read-only observability UI for the Super Simple Software Factory — polls sssf.db in a target repo.

scripts.dev:all: bun run --silent preflight && { bun run server/index.ts & vite; }
scripts.preflight: bun --eval "const { validateToken, validatePort } = await import('./server/auth.ts'); try { validateToken(process.env); validatePort(process.env) } catch (e) { console.error(e.message); if (e.remediation) console.error(e.remediation); process.exit(1) }"
